notes.title: Steam Page Release & Rough Timeline
notes.content:
[p]Hello Radiant Sky community!

Welcome to the first announcement for the Radiant Sky game. The steam page currently gives a somewhat vague release date idea of "2026" so I thought I'd breakdown a bit more of the game's trajectory here and why there isn't something more specific.[/p][p][/p][p]Radiant Sky will be broken down into a series of chapters starting with the Prologue and then two main chapters.[/p][p][/p][p]The Prologue will release as a demo for the game in early 2026, and after that the plan is to enter an Early Access state later in the year with most if not all of the first main chapter.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683357/9190880a2a2d8c1cd8eef708e5b40aa747972851.png"][/img][/p]
